mapper.select:
select file_id as fileId, file_type as fileType, file_name as fileName, file_path as filePath, '' as 备注, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as fileTime from BOK_FILE_INFO where file_type in ('05','07','08')
AND file_name like concat_ws('','%',#{fileName},'%')
and create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{fileTimeBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
and create_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{fileTimeEnd},'%Y-%m-%d') + numtodsinterval(1,'day')
